# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.16

*Version code 74*

## What's New

**Downloads you can read at a glance**
Every active download now shows its percentage, current speed, downloaded and total size, and an
estimate of the time remaining. Most episode streams never state their full size, so for those the
total is estimated from progress and marked with a tilde. Paused downloads keep their size, and
completed downloads show how much space they take up. Series downloads are named with their episode,
such as "Big Mouth — S1 E4", instead of the show alone.

The download notification says the same thing, even with the app closed: the title, the percentage,
the speed and the time remaining, rather than a bare "Downloading". When several titles download at
once, each gets its own line under a combined progress bar. Tapping the notification opens StreamDek.

**Know when a result comes from CloudStream**
Stream results from CloudStream repositories are now labelled **CloudStream · repository name**,
the same way plugin results name their collection. They previously said only "Plugin", which made
them indistinguishable from StreamDek's own plugin system, and never named the repository they came
from.

**CloudStream sources on Home**
CloudStream sources are full catalogues, not only stream finders, and their main pages can now
appear on Home: a streaming mirror's titles, a live-events list, and more. Every source from every
installed CloudStream repository offers its rows in **Settings → Home Screen → Home Rows**, grouped
under the plugin that provides them and labelled with the repository it came from. New rows start
switched off, so installing a large collection never floods Home.

Opening a title from one of these rows asks that source to describe it. When it matches a catalogue
title, you get StreamDek's usual page, with the source's own link added to the sources; otherwise the
page is built from what the source provides, episodes included, and that source supplies the streams.

**Artwork that fits the shape it was made in**
Live channels, playlist entries, plugin and add-on items often bring wide event cards or channel
banners rather than posters, and cropping those like a poster cut away most of the picture. On their
detail pages, artwork that does not suit the space is now shown whole, as a card, over a softly
blurred copy of itself that fills the rest of the hero with its own colours. Artwork that already
fits is cropped exactly as before, and catalogue titles are unchanged.

**Update required, clearly explained**
StreamDek can now tell a version that is no longer supported to update before it continues. The
update screen shows the StreamDek logo in your chosen theme and appearance, the installed and
required versions, **Update now** and **Retry**. If the version check cannot be reached, StreamDek
opens normally rather than blocking you. Supported older versions can receive optional or
recommended update prompts, while a version that becomes unsupported during an open session moves
straight to the blocking update screen.

## Improvements

- **Switch control layouts without leaving the player.** A new button in the player's top-right
  controls swaps between the Normal and Minimal layouts instantly and saves the choice as your
  Settings preference. It sits in the header both layouts share, so the way back is always there.
- **The playing source leads the Sources list.** In the player, the source you are watching is the
  first row of the list, marked **Now playing**, and scrolls with the rest. It is recognised even
  when its address changed while resolving, and appears even if it is no longer among the loaded
  results.
- **Live download progress.** The Downloads page now reads progress directly from the downloader
  and refreshes every second, so the numbers move smoothly instead of jumping every few seconds.
- **More translated screens.** The update screen, its fallback title and message, and the Restart
  Episode and Restart Movie prompts are now translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian,
  Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.
- **Home Rows lists only what can reach Home.** Rows from a CloudStream source that is switched off,
  or whose collection is switched off, are no longer offered in Home Rows. Their on/off choices are
  kept, so turning the source back on brings its rows back exactly as you left them. Each plugin's
  group shows its repository on a line of its own beneath the plugin's name.
- **Landscape artwork keeps its atmosphere.** Wide event and channel cards in a tall detail hero
  now use about 60% of the previous fitted size, with rounded corners, leaving the blurred artwork
  visible around the card instead of covering it edge to edge.

## Fixed

- Fixed clearing the search on a streaming network page leaving the page empty; the network's
  titles now return immediately, where you left them.
- Fixed the update screen's title appearing black on a dark background.
- Fixed CloudStream results being labelled only "Plugin".
- Fixed CloudStream extensions that expect CloudStream's app window failing to turn on with
  "cannot be cast to AppCompatActivity" — among them CNC Verse, CNC Verse Mobile and
  SKTechProvider from the CNC repository. CNC Verse's Cloudflare check no longer depends on a
  part of CloudStream that StreamDek did not include.
- Fixed the playing source sometimes not being marked as playing, or not appearing at the top of
  the player's Sources list.
- Fixed the header of a Live TV **View all** page shifting slightly as the channel list scrolled.
